Investigation

Gray Signal

An anomalous broadcast bleeding through the thick fog of Mag Point. The transmission, appearing only under specific environmental conditions, exerts a profound psychological influence on those who receive it. Its origin, purpose, and the identity of the mysterious Operator behind the Gray Signal remain unknown.

The Gray Signal

No one has a definitive explanation for the Gray Signal’s origins, source, or objective. Unlike conventional radio waves, it behaves unpredictably and defies the known laws of physics. The signal is a low-frequency anomalous transmission that requires dense fog to propagate. This phenomenon is called Low-Frequency Flickering Echo Effect.

The Gray Signal adapts to its recipient. Victims encounter various forms of media, including late-night television programs, news broadcasts, children’s cartoons, emergency alerts, and other seemingly ordinary transmissions. Regardless of its appearance, every broadcast carries the same purpose: to hypnotically compel the recipient to travel toward an unknown destination, after which they disappear without a trace.

The Crystal Peak incident

Crystal Peak SIGINT Station. Facility destroyed in August 1992. Access to documentation pertaining to the Crystal Peak Incident is restricted to personnel with Top Secret/SCI ECHO-1 Compartment clearance.

Intercepted transmission

DATE: 23 August 1992

CLASSIFICATION: TOP SECRET//SCI — ECHO-1 COMPARTMENT

Crystal Peak Unit Roster: Corporal August Pruett (Base Commander), Private Everett Boos (missing, presumed deceased), Specialist Creed Clemens, Specialist Boris Dotsenko (missing), Private Lee Porter (missing), Private Mitchell Rawler, Specialist Saymon Salt.

Note: Corporal August Pruett is under court-martial investigation on suspicion of murder and arson.

During routine frequency monitoring operations, the following transmission was intercepted: “Department U, Main Directorate of Counterintelligence. Order: deliver uninterrupted power supply units to grid square ████████, ████████ . Establish a supply line to ensure transmission power continuity.”

Note: the transmission is low-frequency in nature and demonstrates non-standard propagation characteristics.

Priority Directive: Locate and retrieve any surviving copies of the deciphered transmission. Recovery of the decoded material supersedes standard evidence preservation procedures. Status Active.

Crystal Peak Base

The station’s communications equipment, research materials, and classified archives were destroyed in the fire. The facility is declared a total loss.

“The following day, Private Porter disappeared. That one left no trace. Then, apparently, it was August’s turn. When he saw what materialized at the base with his own eyes, he ordered the rest of the brigade to evacuate, and then he destroyed all communications equipment and set the entire base on fire.”

Operator

The Operator is the name given to the unknown entity, which is responsible for for transmitting the Gray Signal. Whether the Operator is a living being, an intelligence, or something beyond human understanding remains unknown.

SIGNAL 0%
